baseline_compatibility_patch.purpose: Allow NumPy 2 casts to allocate when float64 context is converted to float32; no training algorithm changes.

split.internal_validation: Created only from train_pool; never from the held-out test partition.
split.duplicate_policy: Exact text duplicates collapsed; conflicting labels/tags rejected; near-duplicates are not detected.

limitations: One fixed seed and one tiny repository-authored synthetic held-out set; no external-corpus or general model-quality claim.
Settings were fixed before evaluation; no hyperparameter or model selection used the held-out test.
The two runs in each scenario use identical training pool order, internal training/validation membership, and held-out examples.
Baseline early stopping reports final-epoch metrics and does not restore phase/encoder; those historical diagnostics are preserved, not reinterpreted as matched validation evidence.
The extra cached scenario changes only cache_sequences; it diagnoses training cache integrity, not an independent test split.
